messages:
Priya (Product): Heads-up — we need to finalize how we prioritize the enterprise compliance asks this quarter. Customers keep surfacing three pain points: searchable audit logs, BYOK/KMS handoff friction, and SOC2 evidence packaging. I want a clear gating checklist we can use for launch planning.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Agree. Can we break into impact x effort? My rough notes: searchable audit logs is high impact, medium effort; BYOK handoff is high effort; SOC2 packaging is low-medium.
Ana (Security): Security view: BYOK + KMS attestation is non-negotiable for some finance customers. But we can phase the attestation piece. Searchability + immutable tamper-evidence for audit logs is higher priority for legal/security.
Mike (SRE): Ops constraints: searchable logs at 30qps ingest per-tenant is fine on Dedicated but will blow up hosted costs. Need clear SLA buckets and sampling options. Also need retention tiers + cold-archive TL;DR.
Priya (Product): Good context. Proposal: 1) Launch MVP searchable audit logs with 90-day hot retention + indexable fields (user, tenant_id, request_id). 2) BYOK: soft-launch handshake + rotation docs, GA of KMS attestation in later sprint. 3) SOC2 evidence: provide export/playbook (not full automation) for initial customers. Thoughts?
Sam (Eng Runtime): Sounds reasonable. For (1) let's define the index schema now. Minimal fields: timestamp, tenant_id, actor, model, route, token_count, request_id. We can ship with that and iterate.
Ana (Security): Add event integrity hash and write-once object storage for exported snapshots — even if it's just optional behind Dedicated. That reduces risk for SOC2 customers.
Jules (Legal): From compliance side: customers ask for chain-of-custody metadata (who requested export, who downloaded). Add that to export metadata for evidence packaging. Also retention deletion records are required for some contracts.
Mike (SRE): Implementation note: if we enable full-text search, cost goes way up. Suggest we default to indexed field search + an optional full-text premium tier. Also add a query rate limiter per-tenant.
Priya (Product): OK — decision runway: MVP feature set = indexed searchable audit logs (fields Sam listed) + basic export with metadata + retention policy UI (90/365/never) + BYOK soft-handshake docs. GA criteria: 3 customer pilots, ingest SLA <200ms 99th, retention enforcement tested.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Can we add a toggle for prefix-KV caching on audit queries to lower compute? Might help meet SLA without overprovisioning. I'll prototype.
Ana (Security): Also require KMS integration checklist for BYOK: key provisioning, rotation window, emergency-rotation playbook. We can publish a checklist in the docs.
Jules (Legal): Include a customer-facing contract addendum sample for BYOK and retention choices. I'll draft a short template.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/audit-indexer -> staging (build 233).
Mike (SRE): Action items: Sam to prototype caching by EOW, Ana + Jules to produce checklist/draft by Tue, Priya to align pilot customers and update roadmap ticket. I'll create telemetry SLI ticket for audit-query latency.
Priya (Product): Thanks — let's reconvene Friday 10am to lock MRD and gating criteria. :thumbsup:
